title: Baldur's Gate 3

minimum.gpu: Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 480 (4GB+ of VRAM)

recommended.gpu: Nvidia 2060 Super / AMD RX 5700 XT (8GB+ of VRAM)

notes: Windows requirements as published by Larian Studios. An SSD is required. Default API is DirectX 11 (Vulkan 1.1 also provided). Larian's page also notes the game needs a CPU with AVX2 support.

title: Minecraft: Java Edition

minimum.cpu: A 4-core processor (no model named in the source)
minimum.gpu: Vulkan 1.3 capable GPU with at least 2 GB of VRAM

recommended.cpu: A stronger modern processor (no model named in the source)
recommended.gpu: A more capable graphics card with 6 GB of VRAM

notes: From Mojang's announcement published 2026-07-21. Minimum targets 1080p at 30 FPS on the Fast preset; recommended targets 1080p at 60 FPS on the Fancy preset. Mojang points to its Java Edition product page for the exact specs; OPTIVEX has not read that page, so no CPU/GPU model names or storage figure are listed.
